feed.title: Tech News - Latest Technology and Gadget News | Sky News

articles.title: Britain's weather could be about to feel very different, Met Office warns
articles.summary: The UK can expect fewer winter frosts and more days of hot weather as a result of climate change, according to the Met Office.

articles.title: Stadium-sized crater left in asteroid after NASA 'Earth protection test'
articles.summary: The first images have been released of the stadium-sized crater left when a NASA spacecraft smashed into an asteroid at about 14,000mph.

articles.title: US authorises SpaceX to deploy one million satellites to space
articles.summary: The US' Federal Communications Commission is authorising SpaceX to send a million satellites for data centres in space, the agency said.

articles.title: Hacker sentenced for leaking Grand Theft Auto VI clips
articles.summary: A man who hacked into the makers of Grand Theft Auto and leaked clips after stealing 90 gameplay videos from the sixth installment has been sentenced.

articles.title: Major trial to examine if AI can help detect breast cancer earlier
articles.summary: Hundreds of thousands of women taking part in the NHS breast cancer screening programme could have their scans assessed by AI to see if it leads to earlier diagnosis.

articles.title: Britain's next fighter jet could be last with a pilot in the cockpit, says RAF chief
articles.summary: Britain's next fighter jet could be the last to fly with a pilot in the cockpit, according to the head of the RAF.

articles.title: Anthropic among big fallers in global stock market rout
articles.summary: Shares in Anthropic have fallen by more than 10% at Friday's open on Wall Street, just a day after their record-breaking Nasdaq debut, as part of a global stock market rout.

articles.title: EU reveals it suffered 'AI-powered' cyber attack
articles.summary: The EU has revealed it suffered a cyber attack powered by AI last month and some of its digital tools are still offline as a result.

articles.title: California sues OpenAI over rogue bots' 'dangerous' attack on another AI company
articles.summary: California attorney general Rob Bonta has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing the tech giant of endangering public safety by creating AI models without adequate "safeguards".
